title: Subretinal hyperreflective material morphology in neovascular age-related macular degeneration: A case control study

groups.description: nAMD eyes with subretinal hyperreflective material (SHRM) at baseline; Table 1 splits them by baseline SHRM height, width and area (overlapping partitions)

exclusions.what: BCVA at baseline, 3, 6 and 12 months by baseline SHRM height, width and area (Table 1, T1!R5-R6, R8-R9, R11-R12)
exclusions.reason: Complete-case set (protocol inclusion 5): eyes with a minimum follow-up of 1 year, equal to the last tabulated visit, were included, and patients lost for review visits were excluded.

exclusions.what: Multivariate regression of baseline parameters (Table 2, T2)
exclusions.reason: Model estimates are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4).

exclusions.what: BCVA of the SHRM and control groups and of baseline-acuity strata given in the Results text
exclusions.reason: Not tabulated, and the same complete-case set.

notes: Table 1 does not state the acuity unit; the Results text reports BCVA in logMAR.
The three partitions of Table 1 cover the same eyes.
Treatment agent, regimen and the number of injections are not stated; the Discussion describes the eyes with SHRM as treatment-naive.
SHRM dimensions, geographic atrophy and scar are not extracted.
